# Maffi Bhall

> Maffi Bhall (also known as Maffi Devi) is an AI web engineer from Kaithal, Haryana, India. She is the founder and lead developer of A&N Web Services, the creator of the AI scam-protection app DigitalKawach, and an AI and cyber security trainer who has mentored 2,000+ students.

## Key facts
- Professional name: Maffi Bhall. Name on certificates and degrees: Maffi Devi.
- Location: Kaithal, Haryana, India.
- Founder & Lead Developer, A&N Web Services (since January 2026) — custom-coded websites, SEO, AEO & GEO, AI automation (chatbots, voice assistants). 5.0 rating across 29 Google reviews. https://www.anwebservice.com
- Creator of DigitalKawach (digitalkawach.com) — AI app that scans SMS, calls, links, WhatsApp and email for scams using a rule engine, LLM reasoning (Groq) and VirusTotal URL reputation.
- Instructor at Zed-King Group of Institutions, Kaithal since July 2022: AI, cyber security, Python, web development and IoT; AI Instructor since July 2024.
- Regularly delivers AI and cyber security trainings and seminars at schools, colleges, ITIs and polytechnics across Haryana (including a cyber security seminar at Govt. Polytechnic, Shergarh); 50+ workshops conducted.
- Government-selected trainer for one-week Python & AI bootcamps at six Kendriya Vidyalayas under PM SHRI (2024–25).
- Special Guest Speaker, State Level NSS Camp, Department of Higher Education, Haryana (June 2026) — trained 200+ volunteers on deepfakes, voice cloning and digital financial fraud.
- Chief Guest & Keynote Speaker, CBSE Computational Thinking & AI Workshop, Aryan International School, Kaithal (July 2026) — trained 40+ educators.
- India AI Impact Buildathon 2026 (GUVI HCL, India AI Impact Summit) — Round 2 qualifier among 40,000+ participants.
- Dynamic Educator & Creative Mind Award, Zed-King Group of Institutions (June 2026).
- Credentials: Google Certified Educator Level 2; NIELIT Training of Trainers (Emerging Technologies); NIELIT O-Level (S-Grade in Python); Google Ads certifications; Ethical Hacking workshop, IIT Delhi; PTE Academic 81 overall.
- Education: MCA (in progress), Kurukshetra University; B.A. Mathematics, Kurukshetra University (84.7%).
- Skills: Python, JavaScript, Flask, Node.js, generative AI & LLM integration, AI agents, prompt engineering, SEO/AEO/GEO, UI/UX, cyber security awareness, Arduino/IoT.
